text: Italy's migration-control model unlawfully detained migrants and asylum seekers in punitive conditions and obstructed humanitarian rescues at sea.
short: Italy's migration-control model unlawfully detained migrants and asylum seekers and obstructed rescue at sea.

source.name: Human Rights Watch, 'World Report 2026: Italy'
source.quote: Italy pursued a repressive model of migration control including detaining people in Albania pending deportation and obstructing humanitarian rescues at sea.

additionalSources.name: Amnesty International, 'Italy: Abuse of migration-related detention in punitive conditions deprives people of liberty and dignity'
additionalSources.quote: In Italy, migrants and people seeking asylum are being unlawfully deprived of their liberty in detention centres that fall below international standards
